name: desk-hub
description: The desk's hub: a Cloudflare Worker and its Durable Objects (docs/doperpowers/specs/2026-10-15-desk-design.md, DC3)

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('../desk-web/dist', { recursive: true })" && WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.protocol.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
